title: Antoni Augustyn Deboli to King Stanisław August, cipher despatches from St Petersburg, 1789 (AGAD Zbiór Popielów 17; Unsolved Catalogue 418)

steps.what: AGAD letter lists (ZbPop17.xml, 419, 417, 420, 4) and scans on agadd2; key units 444/451/453/454 not online.
Zielińska & Danilczyk Deboli 1782 introduction (cabinet decipherments in AKP 265), Rolnik 2025, web search: no decipherment of ZbPop 17 itself.
Clear series ZbPop 419 as the plaintext: dates pair for 100 of 106 cipher despatches.
6 Jan 1789 cipher (760 groups) and its clear text transcribed.
Hand alignment of the closing paragraph: lokacya = 623 461 2150 twice, aby = 1900 three times, warunkami/warunkow.
One-part syllabary in alphabetical order, second run from about 1870.
align.py: DP alignment of cipher groups to 0-10 clear letters with an alphabetical-order cost and iterated anchors; 1, 3, 8, then 11 pairs (630 anchors).
Groups 1775-1788 align to nothing (1786: 93 of 94): a null band.
LM gap-filling inside alphabetical brackets on the held-out 18 Dec letter: 5-8 of 171 hidden groups exact; dropped.
Key from 7 pairs, 18 Dec decoded blind: 95.6% of groups valued, 91.4% of decoded letters in the order of the real clear text.
Clear texts of 22, 25, 29 Dec found misfiled in ZbPop 417 (catalogued 1788).

Hand reading of the three despatches without a clear text (read.py, reading/*.fix.tsv): 25 Mar 95.5%, 14 Dec 89.4%, 10 May 84.8% of groups read as sense; groups whose key value does not fit marked unread.
deboli1791's independent code tables for the same code tried on every unread group: agree with this key, three readings added; its code B absent.
Framed 4000 9933 runs (22, 29 Dec) hold French passages in a separate table: the aligner places the French phrases of the clear copies exactly inside them.

Statistical validation (docs/_validate.py): 5056 tokens, 759 types, pl-1790 order 4: reading -2.329 per letter; random keys -3.084 (z 11.6); key annealed onto shuffled ciphertext best -2.307 (mean -2.322, z -0.6); annealer on the real text -2.296. Verdict: underdetermined.

texts.summary: Postscript to the duplicate: Deboli will ask in every letter what Hetman Branicki is doing; the Prince of Nassau-Siegen writes that Branicki is one of the most devoted to Russia; Russia wants no new war.

texts.summary: Potemkin has left for the army; talks with Nassau-Siegen on the rumoured Ukrainian rising, Branicki and the withdrawal of the Russian commissariats; Stackelberg's report that the King of Prussia offers Poland help; a charge that the King wanted Branicki poisoned; 'now is the time for Poland to rise'.
